mapper.update: UPDATE invite_code SET status = 'revoked', updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'available' AND expires_at > #{now}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM invite_code WHERE id = #{id} AND status <> 'redeemed'
